# INDX-CAD

> Reverse engineered parametric CAD of the Prusa INDX toolhead, including the internal
> mechanism. Prusa published the toolhead as a printable mesh under CC BY-SA 4.0; that mesh
> was clean enough for parametric geometry to be extracted and converted to solid CAD. The
> original model and its remixes were later removed from Printables, so the source mesh is
> archived here alongside the reconstruction. Free, CC BY-SA 4.0, no account.

## What this is

- Solid, parametric geometry — not a mesh reconstruction. Fillets, internal geometry, and the
  moving assemblies are all modeled, and the mechanism is complete.
- Reverse engineered from Prusa's printable model, which was licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. This work
  carries the same license.
- Hosted deliberately outside the usual 3D printing model sites, in a lower visibility space.

## Files

Downloads are served from the GitHub repository, not from this domain.

| File | Format | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `INDX.f3z` | Fusion 360 archive | Full parametric assembly, editable history |
| `INDX.step` | STEP | Neutral solid geometry for any other CAD package |
| `indx_toolhead_8t.3mf` | 3MF | Prusa's original printable mesh, archived |

- Repository: https://github.com/robertsamples/INDX-CAD
- Archive of everything: https://github.com/robertsamples/INDX-CAD/archive/refs/heads/main.zip

## Viewer

The page at https://indx-cad.baconmilkshake.com/ embeds an Autodesk Fusion public share as a
live 3D viewer — orbit, zoom, and isolate components in the browser without installing CAD.
The viewer is an Autodesk-hosted iframe, so its contents are not part of this site's markup.
